Adverse Effects, Treatment, and Precautions As for Doxorubicin Hydrochloride, p.712. Alopecia and cardio- toxicity may be less pronounced than with doxorubicin, and ex- travasation of aclarubicin causes less local tissue inflammation. Bone-marrow depression is dose-limiting, with platelet counts reaching a nadir 1 to 2 weeks after dosage, while leucopenia is greatest after 2 to 3 weeks; recovery generally occurs within 4 weeks. Myelosuppression may be particularly severe in patients who have received mitomycin or a nitrosourea. Incidence of adverse effects.
